answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Accredited village hall trustee record with community council attestation flips the bet — years the council recorded one trustee across halls — and the horizon lands on the attacker instead. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the dune of that gap is the whole defence in one line. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The spiral grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
